specific_findings.finding: Existing source requires mouth-corner rise; SF004 near-neutral lip variant must not silently alias it.
Current base profile assumes one adult and physical reflection. Neutral capture geometry and multi-actor variants need scoped review.
Initial positive-name scan did not find Finger heart as a candidate; this is not proof that all thumb-index geometry is absent.
Existing pose tests exclude bare bambi activation. Preserve heel-sit component data without claiming a newly verified named convention.
Existing ultrawide_near_far_scale_expansion, pv_head_tilt and camera-roll components are component reuse references; do not duplicate or impose their broader context.
